story.title: Shirudo Lab and IKUZEN aromatherapy/body-care formats with publicly verifiable BPOM-registered products.
story.body: Public pharmacy listings document Shirudo Lab/IKUZEN formats including massage sprays and aromatherapy inhalers. The products carry specific BPOM registration numbers on pharmacy listings. This TEI profile describes product formats and regulatory visibility but avoids repeating aggressive therapeutic claims from marketplace copy.
